column1: # Traditional Chinese (zh-hant) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); Chinese has one form, so
#                                 the translation is a single string (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Source strings: the same set as ja.tsv (main at a96a621); keep the two files in step.

# image-editing vocabulary in everyday use in Taiwan (圖層, 遮色片, 選取範圍, 濾鏡, 色階 ...). No
# proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add
# entries the same way. Product and technology names (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, OpenType, CMYK, Lab ...)
# and paper sizes (Legal, Tabloid) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is
# kept. Full-width punctuation (，。：) inside sentences; half-width parentheses and the " · "
